HotLoop Flow is a visual flow engine for the plant floor. EmberNet packages and deploys it from the App Store, and the EmberNet docs cover that side.

Where it is on the EmberNet docs:

- [HotLoop Flow on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/hotloop-flow)
- [App Store Overview](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/overview)
- [Node-RED on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/node-red)
- [AnvilMQ on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/anvilmq)
- [AnvilMQ message broker](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/services/anvilmq)
- [EmberCORE access](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/dashboard/access)
- [HotLoop Gateway on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/hotloop)
- [HotLoop Edge Relay on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/hotloop-edge-relay)
- [HotLoop Cascade on EmberNet](https://docs.embernet.ai/docs/app-store/hotloop-cascade)

To run it at a plant, sign up at [embernet.ai](https://embernet.ai/). [Using HotLoop in a business](/business/) covers EmberNet and a rollout by Fireball Industries, HotLoop's master systems integrator.

Back to the [HotLoop Flow overview](/flow/overview/), or the [HotLoop Flow page on hotloop.io](https://hotloop.io/flow/).
